name.text: An edge skew to a given line

questiontext.text:
The tent ABCDEF is a triangular prism. Its ends ABC and DEF are triangles and the edges AD, BE and CF are parallel. AE, BD, AF, CD, BF and CE are the diagonals of its three rectangular faces.

// oblique projection: receding edges at 30 degrees, half length function P(x, y, z) { return [x + 0.5*y*Math.cos(Math.PI/6), z + 0.5*y*Math.sin(Math.PI/6)]; } var solid = {strokeColor: '#000000', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}; var hid = {strokeColor: '#000000', strokeWidth: 1.5, dash: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}; var dot = {strokeColor: '#000000', strokeWidth: 1.5, dash: 1, fixed: true, highlight: false}; var tx = {fixed: true, highlight: false, useMathJax: false, fontSize: 15, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle'}; var cx = 3.3, cy = 1.9; function lab(Q, s) { var dx = Q[0]-cx, dy = Q[1]-cy, r = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) || 1; b.create('text', [Q[0]+0.42*dx/r, Q[1]+0.42*dy/r, s], tx); } function seg(Q, R, o) { b.create('segment', [Q, R], o); } function mark(Q, R, S) { // right-angle mark at Q between QR and QS function u(X) { var dx = X[0]-Q[0], dy = X[1]-Q[1], r = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); return [0.3*dx/r, 0.3*dy/r]; } var a = u(R), c = u(S); b.create('polygon', [[Q[0]+a[0], Q[1]+a[1]], [Q[0]+a[0]+c[0], Q[1]+a[1]+c[1]], [Q[0]+c[0], Q[1]+c[1]]], {fixed: true, highlight: false, fillOpacity: 0, vertices: {visible: false}, borders: {strokeColor: '#000000', strokeWidth: 1, fixed: true, highlight: false}}); } // tent: triangular prism ABCDEF, ends ABC (front) and DEF (back), ground ABED (shape only) var A = P(0,0,0), B = P(4,0,0), C = P(2,0,2.5), D = P(0,6,0), E = P(4,6,0), F = P(2,6,2.5), N = P(2,0,0), Q = P(2,6,0); generalfeedback.text:
Skew lines never meet and are not parallel: no flat surface holds both. For each line, ask: does it meet {@g@}? Is it parallel to {@g@}? If neither, it is skew.

(a) The edges skew to {@g@} are {@sE@}. (b) The face diagonals skew to {@g@} are {@sD@}.

Three-Dimensional Geometry: an edge skew to a given line

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.4: Give an example of an edge, and of a face diagonal, of a triangular prism that is skew to a given line.
